title: Codex wake timer fires but resume delivery is weak
summary: Codex ScheduleWakeup timers are appending ORCH_SCHEDULED_TASK lines to the session .fire file, so the timer substrate is working. The observed gap is delivery/ownership: no durable external wakeup-monitor process survives the Codex tool harness, and the daemon has an in-process CodexWakeDeliverySupervisor but ScheduleWakeup itself does not explicitly register the scheduled session with that supervisor. A robust fix should make daemon-owned supervision the source of truth for Codex wake delivery and expose status/health for the supervised session.
